messages:
maya: quick sync — final publish rundown for marketplace launch tomorrow. need owners and cutoffs for press, blog, marketplace listing, partner landing pages, demo video. can we confirm slots?
liam: i can own the marketplace listing + cloud marketplace publish. aiming for 10:30am PT deploy. need final partner logos and sku mapping from carlos by 9:45.
carlos: uploaded assets here: https://drive.redwood/partners/marketplace/logos_v2.zip. called out two partners with updated co-branding. i'll push corrected copy to the folder by 6:30pm PT.
olivia: i'll own the blog post + social copy. draft is at 90% — need partner quote + compliance signoff. can we set quote deadline to 8:00am PT tomorrow?
sara: PR draft is with legal, embargo time proposed 11:00am PT. legal asks for a final look at 9:30am PT. do we want to keep 11:00 or push later?
liam: keep 11:00am PT to align with marketplace listing go-live and partner availability. ops confirmed capacity for the rollout at that time. :thumbsup:
olivia: 8:00am quote deadline works for me. @carlos — can you chase the outstanding partner approvals tonight?
carlos: just pinged the SI and hardware partner leads. two partners requested minor copy tweaks; they should sign off by 6:30pm PT tonight.
maya: demo video status? we need the hosted link ready at embargo.
jess: demo cut is almost done. hosting on CDN, final encode finishing at 5:30am PT. will hand off the public link to olivia once embargo lifts.
launchbot: checklist update — marketplace-publish: listing (liam) 70%, blog (olivia) 90%, PR (sara) 95%, demo (jess) 80%, assets (carlos) 85%
sara: one quick ops question — do we want a soft launch to enterprise partners an hour earlier? could help soak but risks leaks.
liam: i'd prefer simultaneous public launch to avoid confusion between partners and customers. no soft-launch.
carlos: agree with liam. also reminder: ensure marketplace SKU is toggled in the account before publish. @tom can you handle?
tom: i'll toggle the SKU flag at 10:45am PT and run the smoke test script. will post results in this thread.
tom: smoke tests at 10:50am PT: PASS — listing endpoint healthy, image CDN responding, telemetry within threshold.
olivia: final publish logistics: who actually clicks publish on the blog? marketing CMS or partner co-publish?
jess: i'll coordinate — marketing CMS will publish and we'll POST to partner pages via webhook. doing a dry-run at 9:30am PT to validate webhooks.
maya: locking timeline: embargo 11:00am PT. hard cutoffs: assets final by 10:00am PT, content ready by 10:00am PT, dev toggles at 10:45am PT, demo host ready by 10:50am PT. owners: liam (listing), olivia (blog/social), sara (PR), carlos (partner assets), jess (demo hosting), tom (platform/sku). call at 10:15am PT to confirm smoke tests and final thumbs.
liam: noted. i'll post a quick pre-launch checklist at 10:10am PT.
carlos: i'll do a last pass on logos and partner copy at 9:45am PT and confirm in-thread.
olivia: will queue the blog for publish and hold final publish permission until 11:00am PT.
sara: legal signoff scheduled 9:30am PT. i'll update here once cleared.
maya: perfect — thanks everyone. please react with :thumbsup: when you've noted your owner tasks and timeslots.
launchbot: reminder in 30m: marketplace-publish owners standup (10:15am PT).
